title: Microsoft 365 outage: safety system ne hi aag failayi
topic: Microsoft 365 global outage Nov 2026: latent bug + failover cascade
world: Toll plaza: lanes band hui, traffic baaki lanes pe, wo bhi jam

leadMagnet.promise: Poora outage ek page mein, aur 3 bachaav

caption:
Outlook aur Teams poori duniya mein band kyun hue? Ek July ka bug, aur Microsoft ka apna failover.

Comment FAILOVER, poora outage ek page mein DM mein bhejta hoon.

Us dost ko bhejo jiska 13 November ka meeting Outlook kha gaya.

Microsoft ki preliminary post-incident report ke hisaab se: July mein gateway servers pe ek fix gaya, jo 3 mahine chup-chaap chalta raha. Ek din pehle ~14% gateway capacity kisi aur wajah se band thi, aur Teams ka traffic usi gateway pe aa gaya. Bug jaga, servers atke, aur auto-rerouting ne load bache servers pe daal diya. 2 ghante mein 80% se zyada servers unresponsive.

Twist: lab test kam cores wali machines pe hua tha. Badi machines pe bug aur bura.

Save karo, system design interview mein kaam aayega.

scenes.vo: Friday सुबह, office. Outlook बोला, trying to connect.
भैया, Microsoft hack हो गया क्या?
scenes.line: Bhaiya, Microsoft hack ho gaya kya?

scenes.vo: Hack नहीं. July का एक fix. तीन महीने चुप बैठा था.
scenes.line: Hack nahi. July ka ek fix. 3 mahine chup baitha tha.

scenes.vo: एक दिन पहले, करीब चौदह percent gateway servers बंद.
scenes.label: % gateway capacity already offline

scenes.vo: फिर Teams का traffic भी उसी gateway पे. Load बढ़ा, bug जागा.
Server अटका, तो system ने traffic बगल वाले server पे भेजा.
scenes.title: Failover = Safety?

scenes.vo: Domino. दो घंटे में अस्सी percent से ज़्यादा servers चुप.
scenes.label: % servers unresponsive (worst point)

scenes.vo: किया. Restart होते ही रुका traffic फिर टूट पड़ा.
scenes.line: Kiya. Restart hote hi ruka traffic phir toot pada.

scenes.vo: Twist: test कम cores वाली machines पे हुआ. बड़े servers पे bug और बुरा.
scenes.title: Lab = Production?

scenes.vo: सबक: failover को brake चाहिए, वरना वही आग फैलाता है.
scenes.title: Failover ke 3 brake

scenes.vo: Comment FAILOVER, पूरा outage एक page में DM करता हूँ.
